result.summary: This residential street features continuous sidewalks on both sides, but lacks any dedicated pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crossings or traffic calming measures. The environment is characterized by narrow walkways directly adjacent to the roadway and parked vehicles that obstruct sightlines.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the street without designated, protected areas.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway

hazards.name: Visual obstructions
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb limit visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Absence of sidewalk buffer
hazards.description: Sidewalks are directly adjacent to the travel lane with no physical separation.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crossings to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Reduce crossing distance and improve visibility at potential crossing points by extending the sidewalk into the parking lane.

interventions.title: Traffic calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to ensure low vehicle speeds in this residential setting.

result.summary: This residential street features a continuous but narrow sidewalk directly adjacent to the curb, providing no physical buffer from parked or moving vehicles. The environment lacks pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crossings or traffic calming, and the roadway pavement shows visible signs of degradation.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A utility pole is located within the narrow walking path, reducing the effective clear width for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image on the sidewalk

hazards.name: Poor Roadway Pavement
hazards.description: Visible cracking and uneven asphalt surface in the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the curb with no physical separation or planting strip to protect pedestrians from traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the entire visible sidewalk edge

interventions.title: Install Street Trees and Buffer
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from vehicles.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the degraded asphalt to improve safety and comfort for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at nearby intersections to slow turning traffic and shorten the pedestrian crossing distance.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with sidewalks on both sides but a complete lack of marked pedestrian crossings or traffic calming measures. A large utility box obstructs the walkway on the right, and the absence of lane markings may lead to unpredictable vehicle behavior.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large brown utility or storage box occupies a significant portion of the sidewalk on the right side of the image.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks visible, forcing pedestrians to cross the street without a designated or protected space.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at the nearest intersection to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add curb extensions at intersections to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance
interventions.description: Relocate or remove the large box obstructing the sidewalk to ensure a clear, accessible path for all users.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential alleyway intersecting with a street. The environment lacks formal pedestrian infrastructure within the alley, featuring uneven pavement and significant visual obstructions at the corner.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large metal bin is placed directly on the sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to deviate from their path.

hazards.name: Poor Sightlines
hazards.description: Building corners and a gated structure create blind spots for both pedestrians and any vehicles entering or exiting the alley.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection of the alley and the main street

hazards.name: Uneven Pavement
hazards.description: The concrete slabs in the alleyway are cracked and uneven, creating trip hazards.

interventions.title: Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Relocate the large waste bin to a designated area that does not block the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair or replace the cracked concrete slabs in the alley to provide a smooth, level walking surface.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install wall-mounted or pole-mounted lighting to improve visibility and security within the narrow alley.
